semiconductor_relevance: High — Elead Technology specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging solutions, particularly in addressing defoaming challenges.
summary: Elead Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on providing integrated solutions for the semiconductor packaging process, specifically targeting the bubble problem through innovative defoaming technologies. Their expertise in heat flow and air pressure enables them to offer advanced systems for devoiding in various manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Integrated defoaming solutions for semiconductor packaging
Heat flow and air pressure technology

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in the Jiangbei New District of Nanjing, Elead Technology collaborates with international technology platforms and service centers.
